# Vendored Microsoft GraphRAG source

- Upstream repository: https://github.com/microsoft/graphrag
- Source supplied by project maintainer: `/home/graphrag-main.zip`
- Declared package version: `3.1.2`
- Archive SHA-256: `21b959311878b96fb7b54c667b65fc0e001627ec49c36ac6edb2506504770d9e`
- License: MIT; the upstream `LICENSE` file is retained in this directory.
- Imported on: 2026-08-28

This is a read-only vendored source reference for i兰's offline GraphRAG adapter. The upstream project files needed to inspect, configure and install the GraphRAG packages are retained. Upstream CI/editor files, tests, generated notebooks and example data are deliberately excluded to keep this application repository focused.

Do not add this package to the `wenshu-py311` environment. Install the published `graphrag==3.1.2` package only in the dedicated `graphrag-py311` Conda environment; this vendored source records exactly the upstream implementation and configuration contract that the adapter targets.
